description: This Java class 'DefaultExportableEntitiesService' implements the 'ExportableEntitiesService' interface, providing methods to find, retrieve, and delete exportable entities by various identifiers within the Thingsboard platform. It manages entity DAOs, handles tenant-specific logic, and interacts with other services for entity management.

classes.name: DefaultExportableEntitiesService
classes.description: Service class implementing entity retrieval and management logic for exportable entities, utilizing DAOs and tenant context.

methods.name: findEntityByTenantIdAndExternalId
methods.description: Finds an exportable entity by tenant ID and external ID, ensuring tenant ownership.

methods.name: findEntityByTenantIdAndId
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by tenant ID and internal ID, verifying tenant association.

methods.name: findEntityById
methods.description: Fetches an entity by its internal ID, based on entity type.

methods.name: findEntityByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds an exportable entity by tenant ID, entity type, and name.

methods.name: findDefaultEntityByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the default exportable entity for a tenant and entity type.

methods.name: findEntitiesByTenantId
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of entities for a tenant and entity type.

methods.name: findEntitiesIdsByTenantId
methods.description: Returns paginated IDs of entities for a tenant and entity type.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Maps internal entity ID to external ID.

methods.name: removeById
methods.description: Deletes an entity by tenant ID and internal ID.
